resultsRematch.scope: Elimination in real-time two-browser lockstep; timeout diagnostic executes all original simulation steps with neutral input, bypassing relay/presentation during acceleration; not FPS or latency certification.

rejectedExperiments.reason: Memory retention fell, but full-memory scans made restore approximately 10 ms instead of the roughly 4 ms full-copy baseline.
Exact convergence held, but scanning unchanged pages before restoring did not beat writing/filling the target state. The retained implementation writes all target pages and coalesces ranges.

limits: The diagnostic presents once per 60 simulation frames. It does not measure sustained distinct 60 FPS or input-to-photon latency.

Presentation timing includes reconstruction of native bindings, draw, disposal and restore. It excludes the pre-draw checkpoint capture, simulation, final fresh-renderer oracle and initial Ready/Go/cache warmup.

Referenced snapshot page bytes and allocated pool capacity exclude the live game heap, GPU resources, JavaScript metadata and transient complete-memory hash buffers. Full-copy controls record the kernel-sampled retained peak, not a complete process-memory high-water mark.
Every byte remains covered; mutable globals, audio journal and table/memory/abort guards are retained. No approximate hashes or inferred dirty regions determine sharing.
Native render-side writes are still discarded after diagnostic drawing and require a gameplay-dependency audit.
No production room prediction integration, confirmed-event audio/SFX, speculative-ending commitment, reconnect recovery, or exhaustive roster/hardware/WAN validation.
No game data, supplied binaries, saved-state contents or extracted assets are committed. The embedded helper bytecode is generated from this repository’s own small WAT source.
